# ghdag

> ghdag runs labelled GitHub Issues through workflow handlers into a local exec.jsonl queue, then executes the DAG with claude, cursor, codex, gemini, or shell. Intake (`ghdag watch` / `ghdag trigger`) and execution (`ghdag run`) are separate processes that coordinate through files and locks.

## Docs

- [README — CLI Reference](README.md#cli-reference): commands, defaults, module entry points
- [README — Workflow YAML](README.md#workflow-yaml-ghdagcoremodelsworkflow): loader fields and load-time validation codes
- [README — exec.jsonl task fields](README.md#execjsonl-task-fields)
- [README — Error Reference](README.md#error-reference): exceptions, exit codes, error codes
- [README — Done markers](README.md#done-markers)
- [README — Capability presets](README.md#capability-presets)

## Schemas

Bundled JSON Schemas ship under `src/ghdag/schemas/`. Fetch any schema with `ghdag schema show <name>` (`ghdag schema list` prints names).

- [workflow-config](src/ghdag/schemas/workflow-config.schema.json) — workflow YAML document shape
- [exec-record](src/ghdag/schemas/exec-record.schema.json) — one `exec.jsonl` task line
- [done-marker](src/ghdag/schemas/done-marker.schema.json) — `done/<uuid>` body
- [issue-status](src/ghdag/schemas/issue-status.schema.json) — `ghdag status --json` Issue DAG snapshot
- [context-hook-output](src/ghdag/schemas/context-hook-output.schema.json) — handler `context_hook` stdout on success

## Tools

- `ghdag_enqueue` — enqueue 1–20 steps atomically via `LLMPipelineAPI.submit` (optional step `id`, else `step-<n>`).
- `ghdag_status` — task status by UUID list or Issue handler workflow (`pending` / `running` / `success` / `failed` vocabulary).
- Start MCP stdio server: `ghdag mcp --repo-root <path>` (optional `--exec-jsonl jobs/exec.jsonl`, `--state-dir`).

## CLI

- Validate every workflow YAML in a directory: `ghdag validate <workflows_dir>`
- List schema names: `ghdag schema list`
- Print one schema: `ghdag schema show <name>`
